Need to fix subject.mjs: interior end must move backward, not throw. Also reject split start. Current code: end moved? No — throws when split. Fix: if splitPair(end), end--. Then progress check. Also no need to throw on end>offset? If end===offset and offset<len, cannot progress without splitting — reject. But with end moved backward, end could equal offset only if start==end... offset<end initially since max_chars>=1, end=offset+1 min; if splitPair(end)→end--, end==offset, that means offset<length and slice of 1 splits — reject as no progress. Keep need(end>offset||offset===text.length).

Wait: max_chars>=1 so end=offset+1 initially; moving back to offset means the pair spans offset..offset+1, so slice would split — reject. Fine.
